scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Welcome to Izlude,
Prontera's satellite city.
If you need any guidance
around Izlude, feel free
to ask me at anytime.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
歡迎來到依斯魯得，普隆德拉的衛星城市。
如果需要城內的路線指引，請隨時來問我。

scripts.text: City Guide
scripts.translation: 城市導覽

a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?

請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
需要我在您的小地圖上標記地點嗎？

a location from

scripts.text:

Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Izlude Guide]
The Swordman Association
is located on an island that is
in west Izlude. If you're thinking of changing jobs to Swordman,
you should check it out.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[依斯魯得嚮導]
劍士協會位於依斯魯得西邊的島嶼上。
如果您打算轉職為劍士，不妨去看看。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Izlude Guide]
The Swordman Hall
is located in the eastern
island connected to Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[依斯魯得嚮導]
劍士大廳位於與依斯魯得相連的東邊島嶼上。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Izlude Guide]
Izlude's famous
Arena is located at the
northern end of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[依斯魯得嚮導]
依斯魯得著名的競技場位於城市北端。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Izlude Guide]
You can find the
Marina in the northeast
part of Izlude. There, you can
ride a ship which will take you
to Alberta or Byalan Island.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[依斯魯得嚮導]
碼頭位於依斯魯得東北部。
在那裡，您可以乘船前往艾爾貝塔或拜蘭島。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Izlude Guide]
You can easily
find the Weapon Shop
in northwest Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[依斯魯得嚮導]
武器店位於依斯魯得西北部，很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Izlude Guide]
The Tool Shop shouldn't
be too hard to find in the
northeast part of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[依斯魯得嚮導]
道具店位於依斯魯得東北部，應該不難找到。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
魔法與科技的進步讓我們得以更新資訊系統，現在可以在您的小地圖上標記地點，方便您辨認方向。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
如果看不到，請按Ctrl + Tab，或點選基本資訊視窗中的“地圖”按鈕。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
點選小地圖上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或縮小地圖。
祝您在依斯魯得遊歷愉快。

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Okay then, feel
free to come to me
if you ever feel lost
around Izlude, alright?
scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得嚮導]
好的，如果您在依斯魯得迷路了，隨時來找我，好嗎？
